steam_send_screenshot.note: Part of the F12 screenshot key (screenshot_take). Nothing is uploaded to Steam.

screen_save.note: Part of the F12 screenshot key (screenshot_take). Pressing F12 doesn't write a screenshot file.

FS_set_gm_save_area.note: Called once at startup by the bundled FS file-system extension to choose save folders. The runner has its own save area (the data folder), so nothing is lost.
